verdict.rationale: HeyGen's docs describe creating videos from a text prompt, including a dedicated prompt-to-video model that produces 5–30 s clips. Its Video Agent lets you review storyboards, send follow-up messages, and revise only named scenes while untouched scenes keep their script and visuals, so you can iterate without restarting. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the iteration workflow, and no documented iteration for the standalone heygen-video-1 clip model (iteration is shown only for the Video Agent).

support.subject: As a creator, I can turn a text prompt into a video clip and iterate on the result without starting from scratch each time

citations.quote: Create videos from a text prompt with full control over avatar, voice, style, and file inputs.
Prompt-to-video model `heygen-video-1` on POST /v3/models/videos: text or image to 5–30 s clips with turbo/quality enhancement
Untouched scenes keep script and visuals.
Review storyboards, send follow-up messages, and iterate with the Video Agent before generating.
